question: Does the frozen native loop still outperform untouched Base when both models are explicitly given the induction rule and every question has a single supporting classmate?
protocol: Select 32 fresh official bAbI16 stories by registered hash order, excluding all earlier training, benchmark and intervention stories. Require a unique supporting classmate with the gold color. Give both models the identical explicit system instruction, all nine permuted facts, the user question and the same 768-token thinking allowance. Fit nothing. Use the exact same answer scorer, shared-prefix four-color probe, and end-to-end native timing. Reuse the recurrent weights from the original primary.
gate: At least five net completed correct answers, exact paired p<.05, at least two net correct common-prefix judgments and <=1.5x Base end-to-end seconds. Stop on budget or memory warning. A failed result closes the explicit-rule claim.
instruction: For this task, infer an individual's color from the stated color of another individual of the same animal kind. Apply that rule to the facts in the user's message.
